text: 一个萝卜一个坑——一个顶一个
pinyin: yī gè luó bo yī gè kēng —— yī gè dǐng yī gè
literal: one · radish · one · hole — one · replace · one

meaning.en: Each person has a post of their own, and each is irreplaceable or has a role to fill.
meaning.zh: 一个萝卜占一个坑，比喻一个人负责一个位置，各有其位，人手不多也不多余。

examples.zh: 咱们这个小团队一个萝卜一个坑，谁请假都得有人顶。
examples.en: In our small team everyone has a job, so someone must cover when anyone is away.

examples.zh: 现在编制紧，一个萝卜一个坑，没有多余的位置。
examples.en: Headcount is tight; there are no spare posts.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Often said without the second half (一个萝卜一个坑).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常只说前半句。

text: 一个半斤，一个八两——没什么两样
pinyin: yī gè bàn jīn, yī gè bā liǎng —— méi shén me liǎng yàng
literal: one · half · catty, one · eight · tael — not · what · two · kinds

meaning.en: Equal in value; no real difference between the two. (An old catty was sixteen taels, so half a catty is eight taels.)
meaning.zh: 旧制一斤十六两，半斤就是八两，比喻两者一样，没有差别。

equivalents: six of one, half a dozen of the other

examples.zh: 这两个方案一个半斤，一个八两，没什么两样。
examples.en: The two plans are much of a muchness.

examples.zh: 他们俩一个半斤，一个八两，谁也别说谁。
examples.en: They are as bad as each other.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The first half is the origin of the four-character phrase 半斤八两.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。前半句即成语“半斤八两”的来源。

pinyin: yè māo zi jìn zhái —— wú shì bù lái
literal: night cat (owl) · enter · house — no · matter · not · come

meaning.en: A visitor who comes only when there is a purpose, often a bad omen; someone who calls only to ask for something.
meaning.zh: 民间认为猫头鹰进宅不吉利，比喻来者必有事，多指不是好事。

equivalents: he never calls without a reason

examples.zh: 他夜猫子进宅，无事不来，这次肯定是要借钱。
examples.en: He never calls without wanting something; I bet he wants a loan.

examples.zh: 夜猫子进宅——无事不来，我心里直打鼓。
examples.en: I have a bad feeling about his visit.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. In folk belief an owl (夜猫子) in the house is an omen of misfortune.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。民间认为夜猫子（猫头鹰）进宅不祥。

pinyin: yè gōng hào lóng —— kǒu shì xīn fēi
literal: Lord Ye · love · dragon — mouth · yes · heart · no

meaning.en: Professing love for something while fearing the real thing; saying one thing, meaning another.
meaning.zh: 叶公爱画龙，真龙来了却吓跑，比喻表面爱好，实际上并不真爱。

examples.zh: 他嘴上说支持环保，行动上却没有，真是叶公好龙。
examples.en: He says he supports environmentalism but does nothing; all talk.

examples.zh: 你这是叶公好龙，口是心非。
examples.en: You say one thing and mean another.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. The first half alone is the standard four-character chengyu 叶公好龙, from the 《新序》 story.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。“叶公好龙”本身是成语，典出《新序》。

pinyin: yán wáng yé hǎo jiàn —— xiǎo guǐ nán chán
literal: King Yama · easy · meet — little · demon · hard · deal with
natural: The King of Hell is easy to see; his imps are hard to handle

meaning.en: The boss is approachable but the underlings make trouble.
meaning.zh: 阎王爷本人好见，手下的小鬼却难对付，比喻大人物容易通融，办事的小人物却刁难。

equivalents: it's the underlings who make life difficult
the boss is fine, his staff are not

examples.zh: 见领导倒不难，阎王爷好见，小鬼难缠啊。
examples.en: Seeing the boss is easy; it's the assistants who make trouble.

examples.zh: 办这个证，阎王爷好见——小鬼难缠。
examples.en: Getting this permit is hard because of the clerks.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The same idea is also said as 阎王好见，小鬼难当.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。同类说法有“阎王好见，小鬼难当”。

text: 阎罗王做生意——鬼都不上门
pinyin: yán luó wáng zuò shēng yì —— guǐ dōu bù shàng mén
literal: King Yama · do · business — ghost · even · not · come to door
natural: King Yama opens a shop; even ghosts stay away

meaning.en: A business or person so unpopular that no one will go near.
meaning.zh: 阎罗王开店，连鬼都不敢上门，比喻为人或买卖让人避之唯恐不及，没人光顾。

examples.zh: 他开的饭馆阎罗王做生意，鬼都不上门。
examples.en: His restaurant is so bad nobody comes.

examples.zh: 这个人阎罗王做生意，鬼都不上门，没人愿意搭理他。
examples.en: Nobody wants anything to do with him.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. A comic image of the underworld king as a shopkeeper.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。以阎王开店作滑稽比喻。

pinyin: xú shù jìn cáo yíng —— yī yán bù fā
literal: Xu Shu · enter · Cao camp — one · word · not · utter
natural: Xu Shu enters Cao Cao's camp

meaning.en: To keep silent; saying nothing, especially to avoid trouble.
meaning.zh: 徐庶被曹操逼入曹营，因母亲被扣，终身不为曹操献一计，比喻默不作声。

examples.zh: 开会时他像徐庶进曹营，一言不发。
examples.en: At the meeting he sat in silence.

examples.zh: 徐庶进曹营——一言不发，谁问也不答。
examples.en: He wouldn't answer anyone.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Xu Shu served Cao Cao without ever offering a plan.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。典出《三国演义》，徐庶入曹营终身不为曹操出一谋。

pinyin: xiù huā zhěn tou —— yī bāo cǎo
literal: embroider · flower · pillow — one · bundle · straw
natural: An embroidered pillow stuffed with straw

meaning.en: Handsome outside but empty inside; good looks without ability.
meaning.zh: 绣花枕头外面好看，里面只是草，比喻外表漂亮而无真才实学。

examples.zh: 别被他的外表骗了，绣花枕头，一包草。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his looks; he's all show.

examples.zh: 这个新产品只是绣花枕头，中看不中用。
examples.en: The new product looks good but is useless.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Said of people or products; the first half alone is enough.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。可指人也可指物。

pinyin: xiè mò shā lǘ —— wàng ēn fù yì
literal: unload · millstone · kill · donkey — forget · kindness · betray · duty
natural: Kill the donkey once the milling is done

meaning.en: To discard or harm someone once they have served your purpose.
meaning.zh: 磨完了粮食就把拉磨的驴杀掉，比喻利用完人之后就把人抛弃或加害。

examples.zh: 他功成名就后卸磨杀驴，把老同事都撵走了。
examples.en: Once successful, he got rid of his old colleagues.

examples.zh: 公司这样卸磨杀驴，太让人寒心了。
examples.en: The company's heartless treatment of its workers is chilling.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Often said alone as a four-character phrase.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常单独作四字熟语使用。

text: 泄了气的皮球——一下子就瘪了
pinyin: xiè le qì de pí qiú —— yī xià zi jiù biě le
literal: leak · le · air · de · ball — one · moment · then · deflate · le
natural: A ball with the air let out

meaning.en: Suddenly losing all spirit or energy.
meaning.zh: 皮球漏了气立刻瘪了，比喻人一下子泄了劲，没了精神。

examples.zh: 一听说比赛取消，他像泄了气的皮球，一下子就瘪了。
examples.en: When he heard the game was off he deflated.

examples.zh: 输了一场球，大家都成了泄了气的皮球。
examples.en: After losing, everyone lost heart.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

text: 小庙里的和尚——没见过大香火
pinyin: xiǎo miào lǐ de hé shang —— méi jiàn guo dà xiāng huǒ
literal: small · temple · in · 's · monk — not · see · ever · big · incense
natural: A monk of a small temple has never seen big offerings

meaning.en: Someone with a narrow outlook who is easily impressed by what is ordinary to others.
meaning.zh: 小庙和尚没见过大庙的香火，比喻见识少，没见过大场面。

equivalents: a small-town person amazed by the big city

examples.zh: 他是小庙里的和尚，没见过大香火，看到大场面就紧张。
examples.en: He's not used to big occasions and gets nervous.

examples.zh: 别笑他，小庙里的和尚——没见过大香火。
examples.en: Don't laugh; he has not seen much of the world.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Mildly mocking; not formal.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。略带嘲讽。

text: 瞎猫抓住个死耗子——碰上了
pinyin: xiā māo zhuā zhù gè sǐ hào zi —— pèng shàng le
literal: blind · cat · catch · a · dead · mouse — bump · into · le
natural: A blind cat catches a dead mouse

meaning.zh: 瞎猫碰到死耗子，比喻靠运气碰上好事，并非本领。

examples.zh: 他这次能拿奖，不过是瞎猫抓住个死耗子，碰上了。
examples.en: He won the prize by pure luck.

examples.zh: 别羡慕他，瞎猫抓住个死耗子——碰上了。
examples.en: Don't envy him; it was just luck.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. A more common wording is 瞎猫碰上死耗子.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。更常见的说法是“瞎猫碰上死耗子”。

pinyin: wū yā luò fáng tóu —— kāi kǒu shì huò
literal: crow · land · roof · ridge — open · mouth · is · disaster
natural: A crow lands on the roof

meaning.en: Someone whose every word brings bad news.
meaning.zh: 乌鸦停在房顶，一叫就被视为凶兆，比喻一开口就说不吉利的话。

equivalents: always the bearer of bad news

examples.zh: 乌鸦落房头，开口是祸，你就别说了。
examples.en: Everything you say is a bad omen; don't speak.

examples.zh: 他是个乌鸦落房头的人，每次说话都让人不安。
examples.en: Whenever he speaks, people feel uneasy.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Crows are traditionally unlucky in Chinese folklore.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。民间视乌鸦为不祥之鸟。

pinyin: wū guī xiào wáng bā —— yī gè yàng
literal: turtle · laugh · soft-shell turtle — one · kind

meaning.en: Neither is better than the other; the two are equally flawed.
meaning.zh: 乌龟与王八相似，互相取笑，比喻彼此同样有缺点，谁也别笑谁。

equivalents: the pot calling the kettle black

examples.zh: 你们俩乌龟笑王八，一个样。
examples.en: You two are as bad as each other.

examples.zh: 别乌龟笑王八了，谁也没比谁强。
examples.en: Stop mocking; neither of you is any better.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Rude: 王八 is an insult. Use among close friends only.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“王八”带侮辱性，仅限熟人间使用。

text: 万丈悬崖上的鲜桃——没人睬（采）
pinyin: wàn zhàng xuán yá shàng de xiān táo —— méi rén cǎi (cǎi)
literal: ten-thousand · fathom · cliff · on · 's · fresh · peach — no · one · notice (pick)
natural: A fresh peach on a sheer cliff, which no one picks

meaning.en: Ignored by everyone; no one pays attention. Pun: 睬 (take notice) and 采 (pick).
meaning.zh: 悬崖上的桃子没人去采，谐音“没人睬”，比喻没人理会、无人关注。

examples.zh: 他的建议万丈悬崖上的鲜桃，没人睬。
examples.en: No one pays any attention to his suggestions.

examples.zh: 我这个提案，万丈悬崖上的鲜桃——没人睬。
examples.en: Nobody takes any notice of my proposal.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 睬 (cǎi, to heed) and 采 (cǎi, to pick) sound the same.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。谐音双关：“睬”与“采”同音。

text: 鸵鸟钻沙堆——顾头不顾尾
pinyin: tuó niǎo zuān shā duī —— gù tóu bù gù wěi
literal: ostrich · bury into · sand heap — care · head · not · care · tail
natural: An ostrich burrows into the sand

meaning.en: Hiding from a problem while leaving oneself exposed; looking after one part and ignoring the rest.
meaning.zh: 鸵鸟遇险把头埋进沙里，屁股留在外面，比喻只顾一头，不顾全局。

equivalents: bury one's head in the sand

examples.zh: 你这样鸵鸟钻沙堆，顾头不顾尾，问题迟早暴露。
examples.en: Burying your head like that, the problem will surface in the end.

examples.zh: 他处理事情鸵鸟钻沙堆，顾头不顾尾。
examples.en: He deals only with part of a problem.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。

pinyin: tiě shù kāi huā —— qiān zǎi nán féng
literal: iron tree (cycad) · bloom — thousand · years · hard · meet

meaning.zh: 铁树难得开花，比喻事情极为罕见、难得。

examples.zh: 他请客，铁树开花，千载难逢啊！
examples.en: He's treating us; that's a once-in-a-blue-moon event!

examples.zh: 今天的天象铁树开花，一辈子也难得见一次。
examples.en: This celestial event is rare in a lifetime.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Sometimes said teasingly of rare good behaviour.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常用来调侃难得的好事。
